default_summary: AI Engineer who builds AI-powered, full-stack products end to end, from data and AI workflows to Python backend services and user-facing applications. Designed and owned production systems that turn complex, fragmented data into searchable, actionable products, and shipped customer-facing features across the stack. Experienced in Generative AI, NLP, retrieval systems, Python backend engineering, and production cloud-native software delivery.

bullets.text: Designed production Generative AI and NLP pipelines for enterprise contact enrichment using LLM reasoning, semantic retrieval, and entity resolution over a large-scale Elasticsearch index, supporting reliable enrichment and search decisions.

Built production AI inference and retrieval services using Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for chat, embeddings, batch processing, ranking, and semantic search workflows.

Developed full-stack product features using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, including intelligence dashboards, graph-based discovery, network visualizations, hierarchy views, and AI-powered workflows, collaborating on designs with Figma and Claude Design.

Owned two production FastAPI microservices for enrichment orchestration with JWT, OAuth2, multi-tenant RBAC, provider routing, asynchronous processing, caching, rate limiting, and bulk processing, while contributing to authentication, search, and workflow APIs.

Engineered data processing and retrieval evaluation workflows covering preprocessing, normalization, feature engineering, and query-regression testing, and operated production services on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Helm with CI/CD.
Developed a finance-focused web application using Python, Flask, Django, and PostgreSQL to streamline transaction processing, vendor management, and real-time financial reporting.
Designed and implemented secure RESTful APIs for financial data management, improving application modularity and reducing API response times by 20%.
Optimized PostgreSQL database schemas and SQL queries, improving query performance by 25% and enhancing application scalability.
Built responsive frontend components using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, improving reporting dashboards and reducing user support requests by 10%.
Created automated test suites with PyTest and integrated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker, reducing deployment issues by 15% and accelerating release cycles by 30%.
Deployed production applications on Heroku and collaborated within Agile teams to deliver features through sprint planning, code reviews, and iterative development.
Contributed to the development of a cloud-based engineering design platform by building scalable error-handling infrastructure and performance-optimized frontend components.
Designed a custom data structure to detect and propagate errors across interconnected engineering models, improving system reliability and data integrity.
Developed modular frontend components using React and Angular with model validators and real-time error indicators across linked engineering views.
Refactored legacy UI components and optimized rendering performance, improving frontend responsiveness by approximately 20%.
Collaborated with engineering and QA teams while integrating new modules into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker.
Led campus outreach initiatives by coordinating student teams, managing project execution, and collaborating with brand representatives.
Organized virtual events and data-driven digital campaigns, using engagement metrics to improve outreach and community participation.

Designed and built a production AI-powered contact enrichment platform supporting intelligent provider orchestration, workflow automation, distributed processing, authentication, caching, and scalable REST APIs.
Engineered resilient backend services integrating multiple external providers, asynchronous workflows, retry mechanisms, intelligent caching, and production-ready deployment pipelines.

Implemented cloud-native backend architecture using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Alembic while improving platform reliability, maintainability, and infrastructure efficiency.
Designed and implemented a scalable distributed database platform for hotel management using Django, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL supporting secure multi-user operations and efficient data management.
Optimized relational database performance, backend APIs, and application architecture while improving scalability and maintainability through modular system design.

projects.name: UAV Path Loss Prediction using Machine Learning

bullets.text: Developed and evaluated Random Forest, ANN, KNN, and Naive Bayes models for UAV air-to-air path loss prediction using terrain, elevation, clutter height, and communication parameters.
Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to compare prediction performance across propagation scenarios.
